name: synthetic_cmos_wide
source: ILLUSTRATIVE VALUES, NOT A CALIBRATED CAMERA. Models: lens distortion per Brown (1966, 'Decentering distortion of lenses', Photometric Engineering 32) in the OpenCV calib3d parameterisation (k1 k2 k3 radial, p1 p2 tangential); rolling shutter as a linear top-to-bottom readout; noise per the EMVA 1288 linear camera model (shot noise Poisson in electrons, Gaussian read noise, full-well ADC); natural vignetting as the cos^4 law (Ray, Applied Photographic Optics, 3rd ed., ch. 22). The numbers are hand-chosen within ranges those references describe as typical of a wide CMOS module; a calibrated profile for a real camera replaces them with measured ones and cites the calibration.

colour.linear_source: engine EXR when present, else the 8-bit sRGB PNG inverted through the sRGB transfer (stated approximation)
colour.output: sRGB 8-bit PNG quantised at bit_depth first
